decisions.statement: A definition has no clause saying the thing's purpose.
A definition has no clause saying why the thing is worth having.
A definition has no clause saying where the thing sits.
A second concern needed to cover an area makes that area more than one domain.
A fact true of every sibling belongs on the parent's line rather than on each sibling's own line.
A domain's concern stays on its own line even where every sibling is about the same thing.

definition: the sentence naming what a page's subject is
